register.labelZh: PUFF 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: puff away 可以描述成年人一口接一口地抽煙斗、雪茄或香煙。；puff something out 可以描述某人鼓起臉頰或挺起胸膛,以表達憤怒、自豪或自信。；puff up 可以描述臉、手、嘴唇或其他身體部位因撞擊、昆蟲叮咬或身體反應而腫起。；手部可以自行腫起,而昆蟲叮咬也可以令手部腫起。
register.summaryEn: Puff away can describe an adult repeatedly smoking a pipe, cigar or cigarette. Puff something out can describe someone filling their cheeks with air or pushing their chest forward to show anger, pride or confidence. Puff up can describe a face, hand, lip or another body part becoming swollen after a hit, bite or reaction. A hand can puff up, while an insect bite can puff the hand up.
